definitions.full: H4073. madchephah [ מַדְחֵפָה ] noun feminine thrust , Psa 140:12 לְמַדְחֵפֹת יְצוּדֶנּוּ ( evil ) shall hunt him with thrust upon thrust (Che, compare De).
